title: The scalar tensor square on each total-complex summand
statement: For coefficient data d,h and internal complexes P,Q, precomposing the degree n scalar tensor square with the scalar-and-section image of the inclusion of the summand P^p tensor Q^q, for p+q=n, gives equality. This uses no K-flatness or flatness assumptions.

source.place: Tag 07A4, degreewise ordinary tensor compatibility and signed direct-sum totalization; Modules on Sites, Tags 03EK and 03EL.

proof.text: Fix a bidegree p,q with p+q=n. The signed total tensorator restricts on this summand to its ordinary tensorator followed by the target inclusion. The two equivalence comparisons and the section scalar total comparison satisfy the corresponding summand formulas.
Naturality of the termwise scalar comparison pastes the summand squares. The remaining face is coefficientScalarTensor_ordinary on P^p,Q^q. This proves equality after the specified summand inclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4, the ordinary comparison and the passage to unbounded total complexes.

theorem coefficientScalarTensor_summand (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (d : CoefficientScalarTensorRepresentativeBasicData a Z)
    (h : CoefficientScalarTensorRepresentativeHypotheses a Z d)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z) ℤ)
    (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    let := internalScalarMonoidal a Z
    let F := Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a Z)
    let ER := (ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence R Z).functor
    let ES := (ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence S Z).functor
    let Fc := F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let ERc := ER.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let ESc := ES.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let Bc := d.b.extension.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let o : Fc ⋙ ESc ≅ ERc ⋙ Bc := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex d.o (.up ℤ)
    ES.map (F.map (HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj P Q p q n hpq)) ≫
      ES.map ((((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans (.up ℤ) F).app
        P).app Q).f n) ≫
      (ModuleRingedComparison.totalComparison S Z (Fc.obj P) (Fc.obj Q)).hom.f n ≫
      (o.hom.app P ⊗ₘ o.hom.app Q).f n =
    ES.map (F.map (HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj P Q p q n hpq)) ≫
      (o.hom.app (P ⊗ Q)).f n ≫
      d.b.extension.map ((ModuleRingedComparison.totalComparison R Z P Q).hom.f n) ≫
      (coefficientSectionScalarTotal a Z d.b d.m (ERc.obj P) (ERc.obj Q)).f n
